title: Settings tabs
pitch: Tabs for each settings page, an outline that opens the section you pick and a breadcrumb that shows where you are.
makeItYours: Replace the pages and sections with your own tool's settings.
Point outline entries at any control to jump to it, not only folding sections.
Give the breadcrumb plain segments when there is no outline to follow.
useCase: Use it when a tool has more settings than fit on one screen and people jump between groups.
